TS013 no-global-statement

A function does not rebind module state, so its effects stay in its return value.

languages: javascript python typescript
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable
go: Go has no global statement; a binding never reaches out of its scope by keyword
odin: Odin has no global statement; a binding never reaches out of its scope by keyword
rust: Rust has no global statement; a binding never reaches out of its scope by keyword
zig: Zig has no global statement; a binding never reaches out of its scope by keyword

TigerStyle: "Declare variables at the smallest possible scope, and minimize the number of variables in scope."
NASA P10 Rule 6: "Data objects must be declared at the smallest possible level of scope."
